subject: spanish

moments.title: Fuenteovejuna
moments.body: Lope's play depicts a Castilian village collectively assassinating their tyrannical lord.
moments.takeaway: Spanish Golden Age theatre engaged politics through villages, not princes.

moments.title: La vida es sueno
moments.body: Calderon's play asks whether life is dream or reality.
moments.takeaway: Spanish Baroque drama wrestled with philosophical questions.

moments.title: Lope dies
moments.body: Lope's catalogue includes hundreds of plays. The genre comedia nueva blends comic and tragic, high and low.
moments.takeaway: Some writers produced industrial volumes of work.

now.title: Golden Age theatre now
now.body: Almagro's annual festival keeps Golden Age repertory alive. School syllabuses include both Lope and Calderon.
now.open_questions: How do we stage 17th-century plays for 21st-century audiences?

reflection: Spain's Golden Age made theatre a national habit.
